authority_boundary: This matrix distinguishes owner selections from engineering contracts and evidence. It does not select a provider, cloud/VPS, hostname, DNS, topology, storage, backup destination, RPO, RTO, monitoring vendor, capacity target, availability target, person, or security waiver.

decisions.owner_decision_required: No further selection is required for the code-derived role/responsibility model. The owner must separately select accountable operational and recovery authorities in D8-OPS-AUTHORITY; the charter does not assign people, providers, contracts, or production authority.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Derive role and responsibility boundaries from shipped commands, permissions, reports, and synthetic guard conditions.
Maintain the charter and test that it does not grant production authority or native CRUD authority.
evidence_required_after_decision: Reviewable charter linked to the exact shipped code sources.
No-person/no-provider boundary and synthetic-only guard evidence.
decisions.acceptance_condition: The charter remains code-derived and the operational authority slots remain separately explicit; no charter row is treated as a deployment approval.

decisions.area: Accountable production operation, recovery, security incident, and escalation authority
decisions.owner_decision_required: Select an accountable organization, contract role, or approved authority reference for production change approval, routine service operation, security incident disposition, recovery authorization, and escalation. A person name is not required.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate that the authority contract has explicit NOT_SELECTED values and cannot authorize production by omission.
Prepare role-based approval and escalation evidence contracts without naming a person or provider.
Keep production enablement fail-closed while the fields are absent.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved non-secret authority and escalation record.
Tested change, incident, recovery, and escalation exercises that identify the selected roles.
decisions.acceptance_condition: All four authority references are selected, approved, traceable to the owner/contract holder, and exercised in the selected operating architecture.

decisions.area: Production hostname, topology, trust boundary, edge, TLS, session, and realtime
decisions.owner_decision_required: Select the production hostname/DNS ownership, public and private trust boundaries, reverse-proxy placement, TLS custody/renewal authority, allowed origins, and service placement for application, database, Redis, workers, scheduler, realtime, and files. No value is presumed.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate a topology document against a provider-neutral schema with required fields remaining NOT_SELECTED.
Prepare edge, TLS, Secure-cookie, origin/header, CSRF, private-file, and realtime test harnesses with no target values.
Reject production configuration when topology or edge fields are missing.
evidence_required_after_decision: Deployed edge tests for TLS, Secure cookies/session behavior, origin/header spoofing, CSRF, private-file routing, and realtime authentication.
decisions.acceptance_condition: The selected deployment matches the approved topology and every required edge/session/realtime negative and positive test passes without synthetic flags.

decisions.area: Durable state, files, configuration, encryption keys, and persistence responsibility
decisions.owner_decision_required: Select the persistence and durability responsibilities for MariaDB, Redis queues/cache, site configuration, encryption keys, private files, and public assets. Do not infer a storage service or custody model.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate that required durable-state fields are explicit and that credentials/keys are never accepted in repository configuration.
Define loss/restart and file-integrity test contracts without selecting a storage location.
Keep a production configuration with absent durability fields disabled.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved state/file/key custody record and configuration review.
Controlled database, Redis, configuration, key, and file loss/restart evidence against the selected design.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Every durable state class has selected custody and persistence behavior, and controlled failure evidence proves the deployed configuration matches it.

decisions.area: Backup, key retrieval, restoration authority, RPO, and RTO
decisions.owner_decision_required: Select backup destination and retention authority, encryption/key retrieval authority, restoration authorization, and the recovery-point and recovery-time objectives. No destination, retention, RPO, or RTO is invented.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate backup/recovery contract completeness and reject a production recovery plan with NOT_SELECTED objectives.
Maintain disposable synthetic backup/restore checks as bounded code-path evidence only.
Prepare separate-infrastructure recovery, key retrieval, file verification, and copied-session revocation harnesses.
evidence_required_after_decision: Actual encrypted backup in the selected destination and retention model.
Separate-infrastructure recovery rehearsal with key retrieval, data/file verification, session revocation, and measured RPO/RTO results.
decisions.acceptance_condition: The selected backup/key/recovery design is exercised in the selected architecture and measured results meet the owner-selected RPO/RTO without relying on synthetic-only flags.

decisions.area: Monitoring, logging, audit retention, alerting, incident, and recovery operations
decisions.owner_decision_required: Select monitoring and log/audit retention responsibilities, alert receiver/escalation authority, retention/rotation expectations, and the incident/recovery decision path. No monitoring vendor is presumed.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate an observability contract without selecting a vendor or endpoint.
Define health, queue, database, worker, scheduler, realtime, file, backup, audit, and synthetic-guard telemetry requirements.
Prepare alert-delivery and failure-detection harnesses that fail closed when no receiver is selected.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved monitoring, retention, and incident responsibility record.
Failure detection, alert delivery, retention/rotation, and incident/recovery exercise evidence.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Required signals are retained as selected, alerts reach the selected receiver, and an incident/recovery exercise demonstrates accountable response.

decisions.area: Capacity, workload scale, concurrency, and availability objectives
decisions.owner_decision_required: Select representative concurrency, data scale, workload mix, and availability expectation. No numeric capacity or availability target is presumed.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate a provider-neutral workload profile schema with no target values.
Build deterministic capacity-test harness interfaces for web, database, queues, workers, scheduler, and realtime.
Reject capacity claims when no owner-selected objective exists.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved workload and availability objective record.
Measured database/web/queue/worker/realtime capacity and overload/failure handling against those objectives.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Measured results meet the selected workload and availability objectives, including overload and failure handling, with no unsupported extrapolation.

decisions.area: Release provenance, change approval, upgrade, rollback, and communications
decisions.owner_decision_required: Select release approval authority, immutable build/provenance and configuration-promotion method, maintenance/communication authority, rollback decision criteria, and supported restore-based fallback.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Validate release branch/ref/commit provenance and reject a production release from an unknown branch or missing evidence.
Validate a rollback contract without claiming that rollback is supported or selecting a mechanism.
Prepare full-bundle upgrade and restore-based rollback harnesses for the selected architecture.
evidence_required_after_decision: Approved release/change/rollback record and immutable build provenance.
Controlled full-bundle upgrade and supported rollback or restore-based rollback rehearsal with measured result and communication record.
decisions.acceptance_condition: A selected approver authorizes an immutable release whose upgrade and supported rollback evidence meet the selected criteria; absent evidence remains BLOCKED.

decisions.area: Security acceptance and unresolved dependency disposition
decisions.owner_decision_required: No security waiver or owner override is requested or accepted. Retain REJECT until an official released upstream input changes the reviewed dependency graph and a clean requalification passes.
engineering_work_already_completed_or_al: Maintain the deterministic upstream trigger contract and inspect official released manifests/locks only when a candidate release is identified.
Continue independent production-operations contract, edge, recovery, observability, and provenance work without changing dependency pins.
Keep production configuration and release authorization fail-closed.
evidence_required_after_decision: Official release/tag and changed dependency-bearing manifests/locks.
Immutable candidate matrix, clean relevant dependency audits, affected-path regressions, and unchanged required qualification gates.
decisions.acceptance_condition: Only a genuinely changed official upstream graph followed by clean hosted requalification can move this state; local overrides, waivers, fabricated locks, and fork-like patches never satisfy it.

authorized_when: An official non-prerelease upstream release or reviewed official release input is identified.
The relevant dependency-bearing manifests or locks differ byte-for-byte from the reviewed baseline.
The changed graph plausibly addresses at least one recorded finding and the official compatibility path remains coherent.
not_sufficient: A moving branch with unchanged manifests or locks.
A local resolver result, override, forced lock, unsupported upgrade, or fork-like patch.
Advisory-count reduction without a clean compatible graph and affected-path evidence.
upstream_reopen_trigger.evaluation_action: Only after all authorized_when conditions hold: create an immutable isolated candidate record, run unchanged dependency/native/security/recovery/upgrade gates, and adopt nothing unless every required gate passes.

release_gate_matrix.scope: Scoped hosted/synthetic qualification only; domains remain closed and must not be reopened without a proven defect.

release_gate_matrix.scope: Implemented-slice and isolated qualification evidence; the synthetic guard remains mandatory.

release_gate_matrix.area: Resolved dependency and frontend advisory gates
release_gate_matrix.scope: SEC-DEPS-01 is UPSTREAM-BLOCKED / REJECT; no waiver, override, fabricated lock, unsupported upgrade, or fork-like patch.
Synthetic separate-site restore exists; independent-host recovery, key retrieval, host-loss and measured objectives are unproven.

release_gate_matrix.area: Backup destination, retention, files, keys, and restore verification
release_gate_matrix.scope: Disposable synthetic backup/restore is not production backup custody or retention evidence.
Scoped framework upgrade evidence exists; selected-architecture full-bundle upgrade and rollback remain unproven.
Scoped realtime and product-side containment evidence; upstream task-room risk remains separately tracked and not a production authorization.

release_gate_matrix.area: Monitoring, logs, audit retention, alert delivery, and incident response
release_gate_matrix.scope: Local/synthetic probes do not prove selected production alerting, retention, or incident operation.
Code-derived charter delivered; accountable operating authority remains NOT SELECTED.

release_gate_matrix.scope: No production hostname, topology, edge custody, or deployed edge evidence is selected.

release_gate_matrix.area: Capacity, workload scale, overload handling, and availability
release_gate_matrix.scope: No owner-selected workload or availability objective exists; no target is inferred.

release_gate_matrix.scope: No selected persistence or custody architecture exists.

release_gate_matrix.scope: No release approver, promotion method, maintenance authority, or rollback criterion is selected.
